title: Who is to say No beauty is found In rough edges, a beaury within A geode uncracked No Plato's Cave But a rock Country dumb #smallpoems
summary: Who is to say No beauty is found In rough edges, a beaury within A geode uncracked No Plato's Cave But a rock Country dumb #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Who is to say
No beauty is found
In rough edges, a
beaury within
A geode uncracked
No Plato's Cave
But a rock
Country dumb
#smallpoems
